text.en:
Koromaru, companion of our class student Makoto Yuki. Unanimously recognized by class members and specially registered as an honorary student.
According to his companions, Koromaru is a Pelico beastkin. Locals in Laterano rarely see beastkin as willing to spend long periods of time in human company as Koromaru, and his intelligence and empathy have left a deep impression on many teachers and students alike. Most specially, Aigis shares a deep bond with Koromaru; she is able to understand the meaning of his barks and helps him communicate with others. Koromaru thus quickly integrated into the class and showed a keen interest in board games. He actively watched a class friendly chess match, earning himself the title of "Koromaru the Victorious."
text.zh:
虎狼丸，本班学生结城理的同伴，受到班级成员一致认可，特别登记为班级荣誉学生。
根据同伴的介绍，虎狼丸是一位佩洛兽亲。拉特兰当地人鲜少见到像虎狼丸这样愿意长时间与人相伴的兽亲，虎狼丸的聪慧和善解人意也给许多师生留下了深刻的印象。尤为特别的是，埃癸斯同学与虎狼丸情谊深厚，她能够听懂虎狼丸叫声的含义，帮助虎狼丸与他人交流。虎狼丸于是迅速融入了班级，并显示出了对于棋类游戏的兴趣。他在一场班级友谊棋赛中积极观战，得到了“能带来胜利的虎狼丸”的称誉。

text.en:

text.en:
In the contest for Koromaru's school hours, our class achieved an undisputed victory, a feat well worth recording in the class calendar.
Our competitor was a class in the elementary division of St. Marcheso Comprehensive School, the very class attended by classmate Ken Amada. Their class representative argued that the elementary division was where Ken and Koromaru first enrolled, and though Koromaru was never formally registered as a student, he should in principle be considered a member of the elementary division. Therefore, out of Koromaru's five school days a week, the elementary division should claim three. Our representative pointed out that the middle division has a higher proportion of outdoor courses, and the area for extracurricular activities is significantly larger than that of the elementary division. Considering Koromaru's physical and mental well-being, the middle division is far more suitable for him.
With neither side willing to budge, the argument gradually devolved into a war of honor between the elementary and middle divisions—until Koromaru himself stepped in to end the chaos. With the help of classmate Aegis, Koromaru expressed his wish to spend Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at the middle division, and Tuesday and Thursday at the elementary division. The elementary division representative burst into tears of excitement, though fortunately Koromaru promptly stepped forward, cuddling up beside the representative to soothe their emotions and avert the rumor that "students of our class are bullying elementary schoolers." Let us thank Koromaru.

*One of the sticky notes attached to this page: But Teach, Koromaru spent the entire day on Friday in your office. Shouldn't that be mentioned?
*Second sticky note attached to this page: This is a promise between Koromaru and me. It's fine, it doesn't detract from our class's victory.
text.zh:
在虎狼丸在校时间的争夺中，本班取得了无可置疑的胜利，这是班级年历中值得书写的一笔。
本班的竞争对手是圣马尔索综合学校小学部的某班级，也就是天田乾同学所就读的班级。对方班级的代表主张，小学部是天田同学和虎狼丸最初入学的校部，虽然虎狼丸没有进行正式的入学登记，但原则上他应当是小学部的成员。所以，在虎狼丸一周五天的上课日中，小学部应当拥有三天。本班代表则指出，中学部的户外课程占比更高，自由活动场地的面积也显著大于小学部，为虎狼丸的身心健康考虑，中学部才更适合虎狼丸活动。
双方僵持不下，争论也逐渐滑向了小学部和中学部之间的名誉战争，直到虎狼丸自身出面终结了这一乱局。在埃癸斯同学的帮助下，虎狼丸表示希望周一、周三、周五待在中学部，周二和周四待在小学部。小学部的班级代表激动之下放声大哭，好在虎狼丸及时上前，依偎在该代表身旁，安抚了他的情绪，避免了“本班学生欺负小学生”的流言诞生。让我们感谢虎狼丸。

*贴在本页的便签之一：可是老师，周五一整天虎狼丸明明都待在你的办公室呀，这一点不用提吗？
*贴在本页的便签之二：这是虎狼丸和我的约定。没关系，不妨碍我们班的胜利。

text.en:
Though the members of S.E.E.S. themselves cannot explain it, Koromaru truly possesses the ability to summon a "Persona," making him an important combat force within S.E.E.S. Aside from that, he is basically just... an intelligent and friendly Pelopsian here. My old friend, I know you might have some questions; of course Koromaru differs somewhat from Pelopsians, but this really is the most fitting "identity" for him. We should truly be grateful that they came to Laterano rather than Bolívar.
As for the question of his stay, you certainly needn't worry. Koromaru will travel alongside the other S.E.E.S. members, and he has no motive whatsoever to remain in Laterano. The students at the school are quite fond of him, but children are still young, and their treatment of Koromaru carries a hint of "chasing after novelty." Thus, I promised Koromaru that if he needs to, he may come to my office to rest. This is admittedly a bit of selfishness on my part, for I truly enjoy Koromaru's company. It is a kind of... rare familiarity. Perhaps he feels the same way? I have never asked.
In my time with Koromaru, I have gradually come to realize that he seems somewhat sensitive to the matter of "farewells." And we, too, must eventually part ways... Still, he has his companions by his side, so he shouldn't be too sad. I hope so, at least.
text.zh:
虽然S.E.E.S.的成员本身也无法解释这件事，但虎狼丸确实拥有召唤“人格面具”的能力，是S.E.E.S.中重要的战斗力。除此以外，虎狼丸在这里基本上就是一位……聪颖友善的佩洛兽亲。老友，我知道你可能会有些疑问，虎狼丸当然和兽亲有些差别，但这确实就是最适合他的“身份”了。我们真应该庆幸他们来的是拉特兰，而不是玻利瓦尔。
在去留问题上，你当然不必担心，虎狼丸会随其他S.E.E.S.成员一同行动，他没有任何留在拉特兰的动机。学校中的学生相当喜欢他，但孩子们还小，对待虎狼丸多少有些“追逐新奇”的意思，所以我答应虎狼丸，如果他需要，可以到我的办公室来休息。这当然是我的一点私心，其实我也很享受虎狼丸的陪伴。那是种……难得的熟悉。也许他也是这么想的？我并没有问过。
在和虎狼丸的相处中，我渐渐发现，虎狼丸似乎对“离别”这件事有些介怀。而我们终究也会告别……不过，他有自己的同伴陪在身边，应当不至于太难过，我希望是如此。
